notes.title: おけけぬき 1.0.7
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that prevented the acquisition of skills.
Fixed a bug that caused a decrease in points when using the same skill again while using a skill without duplicating the effect.
Fixed a bug that caused the texture of the legs to be cut off when the number of polygons in the legs was reduced.
Fixed a bug that caused skills to remain at lvl. 1 until restarted when returning to the title after drawing "All Skills Lvl. 1" in the "Roulette" skill.

Specification Changes
In order to prevent a situation where the last few hairs cannot be found in the no-skill mode, the specification has been changed to grow the length of the remaining hairs to long when the last few hairs are found.
Changed so that the skill panel is automatically hidden from view when using the "Remove extra, duct tape, roulette, alchemy" skill.
